and it is forbidden to cut meat with it
it is permitted to slaughter with it -- he is destructive
it is forbidden to cut meat with it -- he is constructive

[Rabba bar Avuh speaks of] a new [knife]

[a new knife] with which he cut a branch for the idol
an old [knife] that he whitened in fire

all agree: the slaughter-site is hot
the one who says 'he peels' -- that is well [the site is hot and absorbs]
the one who says 'he rinses': since the simanin are busy expelling blood, they do not absorb
all agree: the slaughter-site is cold
the one who says 'he rinses' -- that is well [the site is cold]
the one who says 'he peels': through the pressure of the knife, it absorbs
a tereifa knife -- one says: [it is cleansed] in hot water
and one says: in cold water

when does it absorb? once [the site] warms; when does it warm? once the slaughter is complete -- and at that moment it is permitted
